name: Dubai
tagline: Golden dunes, glittering skylines and old-town souks.
description: Desert and skyline in one trip: golden dunes at sunset, rooftop views, a marina yacht cruise, spice souks, the wind towers of Al Fahidi, a lantern-lit desert camp, abra boats on the creek and dancing fountains at night. Elegant, modest-friendly styling throughout.
